_report_url_note: Where the HTML report is reachable from outside this machine. Leave as NEEDS_TO_BE_SETUP here — this file is public and the address is deployment-specific — and set LOREPORT_REPORT_URL in the environment your MCP server runs under. Until then loreport_status reports NEEDS_TO_BE_SETUP verbatim, and assistants are told to offer help finishing it. Handed to CLOUD callers too: security rests on the network auth in front of it, never on URL secrecy. CONSTRAINT: if the report is ever exposed publicly, revisit that — the URL would then be every private entry.
